newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X CEO positive of meeting deadline.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X CEO positive of meeting deadline.

text.p: The president of Bre-X Minerals Ltd said on Wednesday he was "positive" his company would reach an agreement with its Indonesian partners by next Monday over Bre-X's rich Busang gold find.

"Our negotiations are proceeding in a satisfactory manner," David Walsh said in a phone interview, repeating previous reports of progress in the talks. "We will meet the February 17 deadline. I'm confident that we will meet it."
Asked if he was sure about his prediction, Walsh replied: "Positive."
Walsh would not say if a deal with its Indonesian partners would mean Bre-X would finalize its proposed agreement to form a joint venture with Barrick Gold Corp.
He said he was "upbeat" about how much of the Busang deposit Bre-X would end up with at the end of the negotiations.
"But I'm always upbeat," he added, laughing.
Walsh declined to comment on the prospects of an open auction for Bre-X and Busang. In the past he has said he was hopeful.

Placer Dome Inc has proposed a merger with Bre-X, with a 40 percent stake in Busang going to Indonesian interests. Bre-X has made no secret on its preference to deal with Placer Dome instead of Barrick, but Walsh declined to comment on the issue on Wednesday.
The Indonesian government has asked Bre-X and Barrick to reach agreements with their Indonesian partners by the middle of Febrary so the two companies can work together to develop Busang.
